svg.title: H446 2023 Board grid 10 by 20 answer
svg.desc: The Board class contains a 10-row by 20-column private grid array of 200 distinct Artifact objects. The constructor uses nested loops row0 through9, column0 through19, to make a fresh Artifact with value -1 and category empty string in every cell.
svg.text: Each entry is a NEW empty Artifact(value = -1, category = "")
Use a fresh object in every cell — not one shared object reference.
RHS ORIGINAL TEACHING DIAGRAM · NOT OCR EXAM ARTWORK
